title: Rename Data Parade posts to articles: dataparade.io/articles, /posts redirects
description:
Ryan (2026-10-30): the DataParade client wants "articles", not "posts". Move the article pages from dataparade.io/posts to dataparade.io/articles on both sites, and ship the landing side through DataParade's new CI/CD pipeline (Ryan chose: add a landing deploy workflow).

Order, so nothing breaks in between:
1. dataparade.io CloudFront (domain-edge, account 688128002352): add /articles and /articles/* behaviors to the Papyrus edge, keeping /posts*. By reviewed change set by hand: the pipeline's roles do not cover domain-edge.
2. AnthusAI/DataParade-newsroom: urls.basePath /articles, a pattern redirect ^/posts/(.*)$ -> /articles/$1 (301), labels Posts -> Articles, tests, docs.
3. DataParade-io/dataparade: fold the rename into PR #85 (landing nav, footer, home-page feed at /articles/_data/latest.json, next.config redirects, domain-edge template), merge main into it, add a plan/apply landing deploy workflow modeled on deploy-prod.yml, merge, then plan and apply through the pipeline. Note: production landing runs the #85 branch, 226 commits behind main, so the first pipeline deploy also ships main's landing changes.
Done when dataparade.io/articles/ serves the articles, every old /posts/... URL 301s to /articles/..., the landing home page shows the latest articles, and the landing was deployed by the new workflow.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done and live 2026-10-30. dataparade.io/articles/ serves the articles; every old /posts/... path 301s to /articles/... (redirects.patterns ^/posts/(.*)$, compiled into the viewer-request function); canonicals and _data/latest.json are on /articles. Shipped by: (1) dataparade-domain-edge-sam change set (reviewed: only the /articles and /articles/* behaviors added, plus SAM metadata removal); (2) AnthusAI/DataParade-newsroom #39/#40, deployed by Amplify job 29 together with the Papyrus 5.61.0 bump (jobs 26-28 failed on the Papyrus 5.59.0 resolver-path bug, fixed in 5.61.0). While job 29's backend update ran, the new redirect was live before the pages, so I ran papyrus ops content project --all by hand (after a reconcile dry run) to end the gap. (3) DataParade-io/dataparade #85/#130: landing nav, footer and latest-articles section on /articles, and the new deploy-landing-prod.yml workflow. #131/#132 add ECR Public sign-in (anonymous public.ecr.aws pulls hit toomanyrequests on GitHub runners); the role change was applied through deploy-iam plan/apply. The landing was deployed by the new workflow: plan 41088451716 (change set: only LandingFunction image), apply 41099011114, smoke test passed. Verified live in a browser: home page shows the four latest articles linking to /articles/.

comments.text: Reopened 2026-10-30: Amplify job 29 (Papyrus 5.61.0) failed in the reproject-on-deploy custom resource (ModuleNotFoundError cli_login, Papyrus #885) and rolled back. During the rollback, a reprojection with the old backend (basePath /posts) at 13:31:52 ET rewrote posts/, removed the /articles item pages and added exact KVS redirects /articles/<slug>/ -> /posts/<slug>/. Everything still resolves to 200 (the landing's /articles links work through one hop). Blocked on Papyrus 5.61.1 (#889). On its deploy, check that the /articles/* -> /posts/* KVS entries are gone, or /posts/x -> /articles/x -> /posts/x loops.
